key.name: toggle-pin
key.description: Keyboard shortcut used to pin or unpin the currently focused window.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Area of the top panel where the Pin Window indicator appears.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Position of the indicator inside the selected panel area. Zero means first.

key.name: pin-opacity
key.description: Default opacity applied to pinned windows. 255 is fully opaque.

key.name: show-panel-icon
key.description: Whether to show the Pin Window icon in the top panel. When disabled, the extension keeps working via the keyboard shortcut.

key.name: show-pinned-border
key.description: Draw an outline around pinned windows using the system accent color.

key.name: border-width
key.description: Thickness of the outline drawn around pinned windows, in pixels.

key.name: play-sound
key.description: Play a short sound when a window is pinned.
